name: The Gunstringer: El Diablo's 'Merican Adventure
summary: This shooting-gallery themed DLC pack features El Diablo, the Lady of the Dead's husband, as its hero marionette. El Diablo shoots his way through a wide variety of full pop-up gallery environments based on the retail game, along with all-new sets including the Barons oil platform and the Madams bedroom and ballroom.
